run_warp_reduce_sum: run the warp_reduce_sum function to perform a warp-level reduction sum using shuffle_sync_down operations
run_cta_reduce_sum: run the cta_reduce_sum function to perform a CTA-level reduction sum using shared memory across multiple warps
build_warp_reduce_kernel: build a CUDA kernel using warp_reduce_sum for warp-level parallel reduction of numeric values
build_cta_reduce_kernel: build a CUDA kernel using cta_reduce_sum for block-level parallel reduction across warps with shared memory
test_reduce_functions: test the warp_reduce_sum and cta_reduce_sum functions for correctness in GPU reduction operations
